title: I'm making a Black & White style god game where every villager has a life.
author: RiordanRacer

comments.author: RiordanRacer
comments.body:
Solo dev here. Voxel god game inspired by Black & White. You rule the village with one giant hand, and your people react to the kind of god you become.



It's a free early playtest on itch, no key needed: [https://blindcatgames.itch.io/untitled-god-game](https://blindcatgames.itch.io/untitled-god-game)



The narration is an AI voice (ElevenLabs) and the code is written with AI help. I design, direct and test everything myself. Happy to answer anything.
